data.name: Welcome_HelloBody
data.value: Under a minute. You can skip it now and come back from the Help menu.

data.name: Welcome_Step1_Body
data.value: Copy the address of a video or a track in your browser and press Ctrl+V in here. The program pastes and analyses in one action, with nothing else to click.

data.name: Welcome_Step1_Note
data.value: Works with YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Reddit, SoundCloud, Spotify, Deezer and hundreds of other sites.

data.name: Welcome_Step2_Body
data.value: Once the link is analysed, you get the quality, format and subtitles that site publishes. The list comes from the source, so no option accepts a click and fails afterwards.

data.name: Welcome_Step2_Note
data.value: Collections and playlists are listed item by item, and you tick what you want before downloading.

data.name: Welcome_Step3_Body
data.value: Downloads sit in the panel on the right, with progress, speed and time left. Each one can be paused, resumed or cancelled without disturbing the others.

data.name: Welcome_Step3_Note
data.value: The bar at the bottom shows how many are running, the combined speed and the free space on the target drive.

data.name: Welcome_Step4_Body
data.value: This is the current destination folder. You can change it whenever you like in the "Destination folder" field, or per download.

data.name: Welcome_Step4_Note
data.value: A download is only marked finished after the resulting file has been opened and checked. If it says done, it plays.
